rca_of_issue: Original bug: startVoiceRecording used a hand-rolled expo-av options object with invalid iOS outputFormat 'aac' string AND started the REC timer + pulse animation BEFORE the recorder was prepared. On failure the catch used console.error, which Expo's dev overlay surfaces as a red 'CONSOLE ERROR' toast, and the timer interval leaked (stuck REC state). Fix (verified): (1) uses Audio.Recording.createAsync(Audio.RecordingOptionsPresets.HIGH_QUALITY) — valid preset for iOS/Android/web; (2) starts timer & pulse animation ONLY after the recorder is live; (3) on catch, clears the interval, stops+resets pulseAnim, nulls recordingRef, resets isRecording+recordingDuration, logs via console.log (not console.error), and shows an Alert with OK/Open Settings; (4) same downgrade applied in stopVoiceRecording and startVideoRecording error paths. Reproduction (headless web = no mic = same failing condition as reported user env): mousedown on PTT button in VOICE mode → confirmed 0 console.error, clean UI recovery, no state leak across repeated holds.
